scripts.build: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --filter './apps/*' --if-present build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @devproof/runtime-protocol build && pnpm --filter @devproof/agent-runtime-protocol build && pnpm --filter @devproof/test-domain build && pnpm --filter @devproof/contracts build
scripts.dev: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:packages && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
